settings.dynamicvillages.cook.allowed_re: Recipes

ON: the cook makes this dish.
OFF: never makes it.
Cake

Needs 3 wheat, 2 sugar, 1 egg and 3 milk buckets (the buckets are used up). The cook makes the sugar from sugar cane, and leaves some cane for the enchanter's paper. Made at a crafting table.
OFF: never makes it.
Rabbit Stew

Needs raw rabbit, a carrot, a potato, a brown mushroom and a bowl. The bowl is used up; the cook crafts bowls from planks (or cuts a log into planks) if storage has none. Cooked on a smoker (fastest), furnace or campfire.
OFF: never makes it.
Pumpkin Pie

Needs 1 pumpkin, 1 sugar and 1 egg. The cook makes the sugar from sugar cane, and leaves some cane for the enchanter's paper. Made at a crafting table.
OFF: never makes it.
Golden Carrot

Needs 1 carrot and 1 gold ingot. Never dips into the gold set aside under "Gold to leave for me". Made at a crafting table.
OFF: never makes it.
Golden Apple

Needs 1 apple and 8 gold ingots. Never dips into the gold set aside under "Gold to leave for me". Made at a crafting table.
OFF: never makes it.
Cooked Beef

Needs 1 raw beef. Cooked on a smoker (fastest), furnace or campfire.
OFF: never makes it.
Cooked Porkchop

Needs 1 raw porkchop. Cooked on a smoker (fastest), furnace or campfire.
OFF: never makes it.
Cooked Chicken

Needs 1 raw chicken. Cooked on a smoker (fastest), furnace or campfire.
OFF: never makes it.
Cooked Mutton

Needs 1 raw mutton. Cooked on a smoker (fastest), furnace or campfire.
OFF: never makes it.
Cooked Rabbit

Needs 1 raw rabbit. Cooked on a smoker (fastest), furnace or campfire.
OFF: never makes it.
Mushroom Stew

Needs 1 red mushroom, 1 brown mushroom and a bowl. The bowl is used up; the cook crafts bowls from planks (or cuts a log into planks) if storage has none. Made at a crafting table.
OFF: never makes it.
Beetroot Soup

Needs 6 beetroot and a bowl. The bowl is used up; the cook crafts bowls from planks (or cuts a log into planks) if storage has none. Made at a crafting table.
OFF: never makes it.
Cooked Salmon

Needs 1 raw salmon. Cooked on a smoker (fastest), furnace or campfire.
OFF: never makes it.
Cooked Cod

Needs 1 raw cod. Cooked on a smoker (fastest), furnace or campfire.
OFF: never makes it.
Bread

Needs 3 wheat. Made at a crafting table.
OFF: never makes it.
Baked Potato

Needs 1 potato. Cooked on a smoker (fastest), furnace or campfire.
OFF: never makes it.
Cookie

Needs 2 wheat and 1 cocoa bean, and makes 8 cookies at once. Made at a crafting table.
OFF: never makes it.
Dried Kelp

Needs 1 kelp. Low in food, so it ranks last. Cooked on a smoker (fastest), furnace or campfire.
OFF: never makes it.

tip.dynamicvillages.green_names: Items with a green name were made by your village. The Merchant only buys those, and the Cook only cooks those.
tip.dynamicvillages.bell: Ring a bell inside your village to sound the alarm: guards come running, everyone else goes indoors, and every hostile mob inside the border glows through walls.
tip.dynamicvillages.campfire: Light a campfire in your village. Villagers with free time gather round it and cheer up.
tip.dynamicvillages.professions: A villager remembers up to four jobs. Open its window to switch back to an old one without a new token.
tip.dynamicvillages.filters: A chest filter that leaves no room for a job's goods stops that job. If a Rancher, Farmer or Cook stands idle, check the storage room's filters first.
tip.dynamicvillages.library: Work alone only teaches a villager so much. Past 50 Intelligence it takes books: build a Library, or a School for the children.
tip.dynamicvillages.away: Your village keeps working while you are away from it: fields are harvested, cooks cook and villagers eat. Leave food in storage before a long trip.
tip.dynamicvillages.stock: The Stock tab of the storage room lets you order dishes and tools: "always keep 16 bread" and the Cook sees to it.
tip.dynamicvillages.tradesman: Hire a Tradesman early. He sells the village's spare goods to the Merchant even when you are not there.
tip.dynamicvillages.ceiling: Villagers feel crowded under a ceiling two blocks high. Three blocks of headroom counts every floor tile in full.
tip.dynamicvillages.guide: Lost? The guide book explains every building and job, and the wiki at town-topia.com/wiki has more.
tip.dynamicvillages.theme: The Mayor's Theme tab changes how your villagers dress: Modern, Rustic or Victorian, or your own mix.

tip.dynamicvillages.fast_item_frames: [TownTopia] The mod Fast Item Frames turns item frames into blocks. TownTopia reads its tokens from real item frames, so tokens may not register while it is installed.
